title: Choose the visual world for Sarah Ross Office Cleaning
question: The roll assigned The Directory Display Ad. Keep it, take my pick, go canon, or re-roll.

options.label: The Directory Display Ad
options.lineage: Valley phone-book display ads and the listing pages around them
options.thesis: The phone number is the product, so the hero is the ad every valley business owner used to find a cleaner: category guide words, ruled listing columns with dotted leaders, and one display block in Sarah's blue with the number set at billboard scale.
materials: a single real photo inside the ad frame
options.viewport: Guide-word strip on top (JANITORIAL SERVICE, COMMERCIAL · TRUMBULL & MAHONING). Left 7 columns: headline in light Brandon type, services set as listing lines with dotted leaders. Right 5 columns: the blue display ad block holding the photo, '25 years', and (330) 880-8254 huge, with a Call button and a Text button.
options.risk: It could read as nostalgic kitsch if the directory grammar turns into costume. It has to stay crisp, white, and modern, with the phone-book logic doing the work rather than the texture.

raised.raise: The blue ad is one flat, gradient-free block that owns a whole region, and the ruled frame is the only grid.
Listing lines repeat at one fixed rhythm, like a ruler; no card has its own spacing.
The Call and Text controls physically depress on press, with real travel and no glow.

options.label: The Cleaning Log
options.lineage: the 'this restroom was cleaned by' sign-off sheet on the back of every office door
options.thesis: Every row of the log carries the same initials, SR, because Sarah personally cleans every account. The hero is the clipboard sheet, filled in.
options.viewport: Headline on the left, and on the right a log sheet with date, time, and initials columns, all signed SR in blue, next to the phone number.
options.risk: Familiar: most runs for a cleaning brand end up at a checklist. It also leans on the 'cleans every account' claim, which you didn't pick as hero proof.

options.label: Starship Elbow Panel
options.case: Fuses poorly: a black sci-fi console reads nothing like a local cleaner and breaks the white-ground brand.
options.kept: Flat color blocks as the frame and grid.

options.label: VU Meter Bridge
options.case: Fuses poorly: audio instruments have nothing to say about clean buildings.
options.kept: Identical units repeated as a ruler.

options.label: CD-ROM Console
options.case: Fuses poorly: beveled chrome reads dated, not dependable.

options.label: Silk Canopy Chords
options.case: Fuses poorly: it adds colors outside the pinned palette and has no link to the job.
options.kept: Overlap as meaning, used lightly for the blue block over the photo.

options.label: Indoor Weather Sun
options.case: Fuses poorly: amber monochrome erases her blue.
options.kept: One long horizon line organizing the frame.

options.label: Algorave Source Floor
options.case: Fuses poorly: a neon terminal is the opposite of her audience.
options.kept: Upcoming states visible before they happen.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The local cleaning-company hero, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: A split hero: headline, subhead, and phone CTA on the left, and a large photo of a clean office on the right.
canonCard.risk: It looks like every competitor's site, just nicer.
